notes.title: Play Battlesmiths on Steam Now!
notes.content: [p]Battlesmiths is finally out on Steam! Claim your [url="https://battlesmiths.com/news/steamrewards"][u]Day-1 rewards[/u][/url] before they’re gone, including a unique cloak, a premium bonus for the September Challenge, and a unique Steam achievement. We’d also really appreciate it if you could write a review on Steam.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="I6TJj2_lAcQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]This is a very important milestone for us, and we’re endlessly grateful for your support.[/p]

notes.title: CELEBRATING THE STEAM LAUNCH
notes.content: [p]Our Steam release is almost here! To celebrate, everyone who joins us on Steam in the first 24 hours will receive special gifts![/p][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]How to claim your rewards[/b][/h3][list][*][p][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2583940/Battlesmiths_Blade__Forge/?utm_source=site&utm_medium=patch&utm_campaign=SR#game_area_purchase"]Install Battlesmiths via Steam[/url][/u] on your PC, Mac, or Linux, including Steam Deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Launch the Steam version of the game and sign in to your account/create a new one.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Receive the Cloak of Gabe the Great for being awesome and supporting our launch![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Click the event banner to join the September Challenge. [b]Your premium Challenge bonus should activate automatically after you return to the game.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]⚠️ For existing players: be sure to log in with the same account you use on other platforms. Use RR if you have it linked for the easiest access.[/p][p]⚠️ If your premium Challenge bonus hasn’t activated by the time you get your next level reward, simply restart the Steam version of the game.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Don’t miss out — these rewards are only available for the first 24 hours after release![/p]

notes.title: Only a couple days left! Battlesmiths releases on September 22!
notes.content: [p]The Steam release of Battlesmiths is right around the corner! Wishlish the game so that you don't miss the release day rewards![/p][p][/p][p]That's it, that's the post :) [/p]

notes.title: Battlesmiths comes to Steam on September 22!
notes.content: [p][b]Battlesmiths arrives on Steam on September 22, 2025[/b]! Add the game to your wishlist now to get a launch-day notification and receive unique rewards![/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]What to expect[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Full content parity with other platforms[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Deck support — play Battlesmiths anywhere on a bigger screen![/p][/*][*][p]Steam achievements[/p][/*][*][p]New authorisation method — Steam ID. To keep all your previous progress, log in via your current authorisation method (RR authorisation will be the easiest and most reliable). After that you’ll be able to link your Steam ID to your profile as usual. Keep in mind that Steam version doesn’t support guest authentication[/p][/*][*][p][b]24-hour launch celebration[/b] with an exclusive cloak and a gift premium for the September Challenge for those who log into their account via Steam on the first day after release![/p][/*][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2583940/Battlesmiths_Blade__Forge/"][u]Wishlist Battlesmiths[/u][/url] to support the release and not miss any of the rewards![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]See you at the forge on September 22.[/p]

notes.title: Battlesmiths: Blade & Forge announced Steam Deck support
notes.content:
Battlesmiths: Blade & Forge is a tactical RPG where every piece of gear is forged by you, and there's also some town-building involved too.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/battlesmiths-blade-forge-announced-steam-deck-support/

notes.title: Battlesmiths on Steam Deck? Yes!
notes.content: [p]Hey Battlesmiths,[/p][p][/p][p]While we're still some time away from the Steam release of our game, we'd like to share the news concerning Steam Deck playability. Our testing shows great results with launching and playing Battlesmiths on Steam Deck (in fact, some of our developers now prefer it to any other platform).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648034/e7d47ca7aedb3d668bb7b823338a53bbc7ec6857.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We can safely say that Battlesmiths is already fully playable on Steam Deck via the already available touch screen control options and [b]will be compatible with Steam Deck upon Steam release[/b] (screenshots captured on Steam Deck below).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648034/fe0436f0e67d75831ff94558b9bc26e125e6a0f2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648034/eff1775541cd49a5f15744efa3926ee423c1ae99.jpg"][/img][/p]
